en: Come now, there's no need to die over it.
It'll be all right. I'm sure you'll find
a new love in no time.

When a handsome guy like you tells me that,
it's hard to just nod along, but somehow
I'm starting to think you're right
note: No final punctuation: #2 '...' + #414 '!' follow -> 'right...!'

en: You've listened to all my troubles till now.
Now it's my turn to listen to yours.
So what is it?
I'd rather no one else heard this.
Would you lend me your ear for a moment?
*shiver shiver*...
...Fighting's so scaaary...

en: Come on, just steel yourself and fight.
...*shiver shiver*...
Your strength is genuine... Fear not,
and fight.

Who the heck are you...

en: Don't tell me you've got battle orders from the army.
I've had it with fighting, I tell ya!
You are a soldier, are you not?
Why do you fear battle?
Just leave me alone.
I just ain't cut out to be a soldier.
Anyway, in this world there's stuff you're
cut out for and stuff you ain't, see,
and I just ain't cut out to be a soldier.
We were dirt poor, and on top of that I had
a whole slew of brothers and sisters,
note: Siblings rendered 'brothers and sisters' (gender of siblings unknown; generic reading).

en: so I decided to join the army.
But see, I can't stand blood.
The second I see an enemy soldier's blood,
I just go clean out of my head.
And in the end, I keel right over.
Because you left the front lines that way,
isn't that why you're still alive today?
Yeah, that's gotta be it. Hahaha.
This fine medal... is it yours?
Oh, that?
